title: Gonorrhea screening in women 25 years or older at increased risk

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for gonorrhea in all sexually active women 24 years or younger and in women 25 years or older who are at increased risk for infection.

uncomputable.needs: clinician assessment of increased risk for gonorrhea infection (sexual/exposure risk)
